title: SQL Expert
description: 10 expert-level SQL Server problems covering temp tables, MERGE, JSON, window frames, grouping sets, keyset pagination, and query hints.
longDescription: This module covers the topics that separate a strong senior candidate from an average one: temporary table strategy, MERGE upserts with concurrency safety, JSON and OPENJSON, ROWS vs RANGE window frames, ROLLUP/CUBE/GROUPING SETS, keyset pagination, and how to reason about query hints without reaching for them by default.
whatYouLearn: Choose correctly between temp tables, table variables, and CTEs
Query and shape JSON inside SQL Server
Reason about window frames, grouping sets, and pagination
